How to Generate Leads Using Facebook & Instagram Ads

Meta platforms offer highly effective advertising tools to capture customer leads. We explain how to set up lead generation campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.

Utilize Meta Instant Forms to Reduce Friction

Instant Forms allow users to submit their contact details directly within the Facebook or Instagram app. This simplifies the process for mobile users and improves lead volume compared to standard external pages.

Design Scroll-Stopping Ad Creatives

To get users to stop scrolling, use high-contrast images, clear headlines, and short video demonstrations. Test multiple layouts and copy angles to find the combination that generates the most forms.

Set Up Custom Audiences and Retargeting

Build custom audience groups of users who have visited your website or engaged with your social profiles. Retargeting these warm prospects with specific offers is highly effective at driving conversions.
